name: Plant Label
description: A plant name on a flat label, as a garden stake, an arrow-shaped stake, a clip that hooks over a pot rim, or a hanging tag. The letters are raised or inlaid flush and shrink to fit the label. Prints flat without supports, in two colours: the label on extruder 1, the letters on extruder 2.
source: inspired by Printables Fully Customizable PET Bottle Watering Spike/Plant Label and Stylish Plant Labels
